data.standardized_narrative: No reliable gross claims reserves movement or prior-year development figures could be extracted from the provided images. The annual report pages supplied are rotated and low-resolution which prevented reading the balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' gross amounts and the movement note for prior year reserves. Gross premium totals were legible.
data.data_quality_notes: Document images are low-resolution and rotated; many numeric lines (in particular the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note) are not legible. I therefore could not reliably extract the opening gross claims outstanding or a gross prior-year development figure. The total gross premiums written (311,604 thousand) was readable on the segmental analysis page but the individual class lines and their exact labels/amounts were not legible enough to transcribe with confidence. No explicit verbatim sentence describing prior-year reserve movement could be read. If you can provide a higher-resolution, correctly oriented PDF (or the specific pages: Balance Sheet / Technical provisions note / Movement in prior year provision note / Segmental analysis) I can extract the requested fields precisely.
